task.description: Write regression tests proving ISS-0733's two gaps are fixed. This run has TWO distinct fail-first situations -- handle each per WF-03_issue_resolving.md's own rule for which applies: GAP A (write path) is a fix to EXISTING behaviour (promote_definition/3 already existed pre-fix) -- write a test that calls promote_definition/3 (or apply_review/4) with a real event_appender and asserts exactly one audit_entries row now exists with action 'definition.promote' and the expected after_state fields (source_tenant_id, target_tenant_id, source_definition_id, target_definition_id, process_key) after a successful promotion. Prove this genuinely fails pre-fix and passes post-fix: check out main (pre-fix) in a throwaway worktree, run an equivalent assertion (0 audit entries after a successful promotion) to confirm it holds pre-fix, then confirm post-fix on this branch it finds exactly 1. GAP B (read path) is NEW code (list_platform_events/1 and GET /promotions/platform-events did not exist pre-fix at all) -- the fail-first rule is trivially satisfied by UndefinedFunctionError/404, which proves nothing about correctness. Per WF-03's 'non-existence' section, MUTATE the shipped logic in throwaway ways targeting real traps (e.g.: wrong instance_id filter picks up non-platform events; cursor pagination off-by-one includes/excludes a boundary row; missing PLATFORM_ADMIN authz check lets an unauthorized caller through; event_type filter ignored) and record which tests fail for each mutant, in a throwaway git worktree, cleanly removed afterward -- verify with git status --porcelain empty and a clean re-run to green. Write the tests as real ExUnit test files under test/letflow/. Do not implement any fix code -- tests only.
acceptance_criteria: GAP A: at least one test demonstrated to fail (0 audit entries found) against main and pass (1 correct entry found) against this branch, both runs' output quoted
GAP B: mutation coverage recorded for at least 3 distinct real traps (authz bypass, wrong instance_id/tenant scoping, pagination boundary), each mutant's failing test count quoted
Every mutation applied in a throwaway worktree or reverted-and-verified in place (git status --porcelain empty, re-run green, both quoted)
Tests cover the design doc's stated acceptance-criteria mapping section in full
